summary.goal: Wire replan_count and escalation_count in RunOutcomeEmission to actual RunService counters instead of hardcoded 0. The TaskFailureHandler already implements a recovery ladder (retry → revise → rollback → branch → escalate → skip) and ReplanConfig exists with cascade failure thresholds, but neither tracks counts that flow to the outcome emission. These counts are critical for Tuner's drift detection — they indicate run health and recovery patterns.

acceptance_criteria.description: escalation_count increments each time TaskFailureHandler escalates a task (RecoveryStrategy.Escalate)
replan_count increments each time a replan is triggered (cascade failure threshold exceeded per ReplanConfig)
Counts are per-run and persisted (survive server restart via checkpoint)
Counts are available in run detail API response for observability
Tuner drift detection can use non-zero replan/escalation counts as health signals

observations: RunOutcomeEmission in run-service.ts has replan_count and escalation_count fields (recently added)
Orchestrator finalizeRun() and failRun() set both to 0 with TODO comments
TaskFailureHandler in recovery.ts implements recovery ladder: retry → revise → rollback → branch → escalate → skip
RecoveryStrategy.Escalate exists but doesn't increment a counter — it creates a gate
ReplanConfig in types.ts has on_cascade_failure (bool) and threshold_blocked_tasks (default 3)
No replan logic is actually triggered yet — the config exists but cascade detection doesn't call anything
RunService tracks state per-run but no counter fields for replans/escalations
Checkpoint system exists for durability — counts should be included in checkpoint snapshots
patterns: Counter stored on Run entity or in RunService's per-run state Map
Increment at decision point in TaskFailureHandler (escalation) and RunService (replan)
Flow to outcome emission in finalizeRun/failRun

counter_storage_options.option_a: Add replan_count/escalation_count columns to runs table
counter_storage_options.option_b: Track in RunService per-run state Map (lost on restart unless checkpointed)
counter_storage_options.option_c: Derive from trajectory events (count events of type escalation/replan)

architect.recommended: option_a (explicit columns) for simplicity and queryability
